title: W. C. Handy in Chicago and Lil Hardin
summary: He says he took Handy's job in Chicago, where Handy's band preceded his, and that his pianist was Lil Hardin.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: playing? Did he ever visit you? One time I met Mr. Handy, I took his job in Chicago. He was,
